_comment: Hand-maintained source registry. Content items cite these by id, never by free text. Adding a source here is how it becomes citable. Tier 1 = official government or certification authority. Tier 2 = industry association or manufacturer technical data. Tier 3 = general technical reference. 'quotable: false' means the text is paid or restricted — describe its scope in your own words, never reproduce it.

sources.title: 労働安全衛生法 関係法令
sources.titleEn: Industrial Safety and Health Act and related regulations
sources.publisher: 厚生労働省 (MHLW)
sources.note: Governs work at height, PPE, scaffolding and site safety. Primary anchor for chapters 08 and 09. Note 規則第620条 (労働者の清潔保持義務): a duty on the WORKER to attend to the cleanliness of the work area and not to discard waste anywhere but the place set aside for it — the legal root of daily housekeeping, and easily missed next to 第619条, whose six-monthly deep clean is aimed at premises an employer holds over time. Also 法第26条 and 第32条第6項・第7項, which are why a rule from a company that does not employ you can bind you.

sources.title: 墜落災害防止のための移動はしごの使用方法等について
sources.titleEn: Use of portable ladders for the prevention of falls from height
sources.publisher: 独立行政法人 労働安全衛生総合研究所 (JNIOSH) / 一般社団法人 全国建設業労災互助会
sources.note: National occupational-safety research institute, co-published with a construction mutual-aid association. Analyses 103 fatal ladder falls in construction over ten years, split by work type and by whether the victim was climbing or working. States the three-point climbing rule — three of the four hand and foot points stay on the ladder. Source for the 103 / 52 / 29 / 22 breakdown, the 設備工事 share, the five recurring failure patterns, and the 75-degree set-up angle. Tier 2 rather than 1: it is analysis and guidance, not regulation. Copyright of the publishing bodies — describe the findings, never reproduce text or figures.

sources.title: 低所での作業　あなたは油断していませんか？（はしご・脚立・可搬式作業台）
sources.titleEn: Working at low height — leaflet on ladders, stepladders and mobile work platforms
sources.publisher: 建設業労働災害防止協会 (JCOSHA)
sources.note: Industry association leaflet, footer dated 2025.3. States three-point contact as a rule for climbing (3点支持), plus: do not climb holding objects, do not come down facing away from the ladder, and use a ladder for access rather than as a place to work. Also the source for the 2013-2022 fatality averages, the helmet findings, and the 75-degree / 60 cm set-up figures. The filename is a content hash, so the URL may break when the leaflet is revised — re-check at the recheck date. Paraphrase only.

sources.title: 建設業法（昭和24年法律第100号）
sources.titleEn: Construction Business Act
sources.publisher: e-Gov 法令検索 / 総務省
sources.note: The Act that licenses construction businesses by trade category, bans passing a whole job straight to another company (第22条 一括下請負の禁止), requires a 主任技術者 on site for every licensed contractor (第26条), and requires the prime contractor to keep a 施工体制台帳 and post a 施工体系図 once subcontracting passes a stated value (第24条の8). Japanese statute text is outside copyright under 著作権法第13条, so it is quotable — but paraphrase anyway, because the readers here need plain English rather than legal Japanese.

sources.title: 業種区分、建設工事の内容、例示、区分の考え方（平成29年11月10日改正）
sources.titleEn: MLIT table of construction trade categories, their scope, examples and boundaries
sources.publisher: 国土交通省 (MLIT)
sources.note: Consolidates the 建設業法別表, the 告示 defining each trade category, and the 建設業許可事務ガイドライン examples. Source for what 熱絶縁工事 covers, for 管工事 including duct installation and air-conditioning, and for 電気工事 and 消防施設工事 being separate categories from it. Paraphrase; do not reproduce the table.

sources.title: 公共建築工事標準仕様書（機械設備工事編）令和7年版（修補版）
sources.titleEn: Standard specification for public building works, mechanical services volume, 2025 edition (revised print)
sources.publisher: 国土交通省大臣官房官庁営繕部
sources.note: **The landing page carries two prints — 令和7年版（修補版）, 2025-11-05, and 令和7年版, 2025-05-12 with its own 正誤表. Everything cited in this project was read from the 修補版; take that one.** **Clause numbers repeat across the document's 編.** 1.5.3 is 一工程の施工の確認及び報告 in 第1編 一般共通事項, and also 冷凍機, and also 連結送水管, elsewhere in the same file — three different subjects under one number. A bare clause number identifies nothing; name the 編. The general clauses this project cites most (1.2.x, 1.3.x, 1.4.x, 1.5.x, 1.6.x, 1.7.x) are all 第1編. Found while building the 01.3 pack; it is the same trap as the 要綱's two volumes. Free official specification governing mechanical services work on government building projects, and the model most private specifications in Japan follow. Source for: pressure and airtightness testing being completed before concealment, before painting and before insulation is applied (2.9.1); rock wool at the insulated penetration of a fire compartment; no metal jacketing around a dielectric joint; refrigerant lines insulated only after the airtightness test and liquid and gas lines never wrapped together; no insulation within 25 mm of a wall or floor face on steam pipework; and the duty to record and photograph work that will become concealed. Reissued every few years (2022 then 2025), so re-verify clause numbers at the recheck date. Paraphrase only.

sources.title: 公共工事の入札及び契約の適正化の促進に関する法律（平成12年法律第127号）
sources.titleEn: Act on Promoting Proper Tendering and Contracting for Public Works
sources.publisher: e-Gov 法令検索 / 総務省
sources.note: The statute that tightens 建設業法 for public work. 第15条第1項 rewrites 建設業法第24条の8 for public projects: the duty falls on any licensed contractor rather than only a 特定建設業者, the monetary threshold is replaced by the mere fact of having subcontracted at all, and the 施工体系図 must be posted where the public can see it as well as where site workers can. Read the full text through the e-Gov API rather than the web page, which is a script shell. Statute text is outside copyright under 著作権法第13条, but paraphrase anyway.
namedAs: 公共工事の入札及び契約の適正化

sources.title: 営繕工事における週休２日（現場閉所）工事のモニタリングについて
sources.titleEn: Monitoring of two-day-weekend (site closure) working on government building projects
sources.publisher: 国土交通省大臣官房官庁営繕部計画課
sources.note: The same department that issues 公共建築工事標準仕様書 tracks whether government building sites actually close. Defines 週休2日 as 4週8休以上の現場閉所 — eight days of site closure in every four weeks — and publishes monitoring results. Source for the claim that the industry is pushing for site closure rather than merely for shorter hours. It is a target being monitored, not an achieved state, and it governs public work; how far it reaches a six-person subcontractor is not settled by it.

sources.title: 建設工事公衆災害防止対策要綱（土木工事等編・建築工事等編）
sources.titleEn: Outline of measures to prevent public damage from construction work, building works volume
sources.publisher: 国土交通省 (MLIT) — 令和元年9月2日 国土交通省告示第496号
sources.note: MLIT 告示 496号 of 2 September 2019. **The file at this URL carries both volumes — 土木工事等編 first, 建築工事等編 second — under that single 告示. This project cites the 建築工事等編, which begins partway through the file, and the clause numbers mean different things in the two volumes: 第16 is 粉塵対策 in the building volume and 作業場の出入口 in the civil one, 第19 is 危険物貯蔵 against 足場等の設置・解体, 第33 is 歩行者用通路の確保 against bridge erection over a road. Name the volume whenever you cite a number.** The national rule set for protecting people who are not part of the work — 公衆 — from a building job. 第1 defines 公衆災害 as harm to the life, body and property of third parties AND nuisance to them, and 第2 covers building, repair, alteration and removal, so renovation inside an occupied building is in scope. Building-volume source for: keeping the work area and its surroundings tidy so dust does not reach the neighbours (第14); damping or covering a dust source (第16); providing lighting where existing lighting is removed or moved (第17); fire prevention where fire or sparks are used, including a watcher and limiting spark travel (第18); storage of flammable materials in a labelled, ventilated store with a named supervisor, which applies 関係法令等に従い and therefore through fire law's quantity thresholds (第19); 1.8 m hoarding, gates kept closed and signed against public entry (第21); surveying the delivery route in advance (第22); safety patrol (第30); and the pedestrian route dimensions where a job restricts a route the public uses — 0.90 m, 0.75 m where elderly and wheelchair users are not expected, 1.5 m where there are many pedestrians, 2.1 m effective height (第33). 第33 sits in the traffic chapter and is written for roads and public footways, not for a corridor inside a building — do not present it as an internal rule. A 告示 is outside copyright under 著作権法第13条, so it is quotable, but paraphrase anyway.
namedAs: 建設工事公衆災害防止対策要綱
公衆災害防止対策要綱

sources.title: 廃棄物の処理及び清掃に関する法律（昭和45年法律第137号）及び同法施行規則
sources.titleEn: Waste Management and Public Cleansing Act, and its enforcement ordinance
sources.publisher: e-Gov 法令検索 / 総務省
sources.note: Decides who owns the waste a construction job produces. 第21条の3第1項: where the work is carried out through successive subcontracts, the 元請業者 — the contractor that took the job directly from the client — is the 事業者 for the waste arising from it, so disposal and its paperwork are the prime contractor's duty. 第2項: the subcontractor is nevertheless deemed the 事業者 for storage, so the storage standards in 第12条第2項 apply to it — **the content of those standards is in 施行規則第8条, which has NOT been read for this registry entry; do not describe it.** 第4項: where a subcontractor entrusts carriage or disposal to somebody else, it is deemed the 事業者 for the 委託基準 and the manifest, which is a much heavier set of duties. 第3項, read with 施行規則第18条の2, is the exception letting a subcontractor carry the waste itself. It needs a written term in the subcontract, and every one of: the waste is NOT 特別管理一般廃棄物 or 特別管理産業廃棄物 (this is the condition most likely to bite this trade — 廃石綿等 from removing asbestos-containing building material is specially controlled industrial waste under 施行令第2条の4); the work is not demolition, new build or extension; the contract value is 5,000,000 yen or less — **the clause attaches this to the 建設工事 whose 元請業者 is the generator, i.e. the prime contract, not the subcontract; secondary commentary agrees and no 環境省 通知 was read directly**; split contracts are aggregated for that test unless split for a legitimate reason (施行規則第18条の2第2項); each load is 1 m³ or less, 区分して運搬 so the VOLUME per trip is demonstrable (this is not segregation by waste type); the destination is a facility in the prefecture where the waste arose or one adjacent to it — measured from the site, not the company base — which the 元請業者 owns or has the right to use; and no storage en route. A consequence worth stating: because the destination must be the prime contractor's facility, carrying offcuts back to the subcontractor's own yard is generally outside this route. A carriage document is also required in the vehicle under the 施行令 処理基準, which has not been read here. Read through the e-Gov API rather than the web page. Statute text is outside copyright under 著作権法第13条, but paraphrase anyway.
namedAs: 廃棄物の処理及び清掃に関する法律
